brief:
Israeli occupation forces issued demolition notices for residential structures and sheep pens in Mughayyir al-Abeed in Masafer Yatta, the Ma'an news agency reported. The area, located in the southern West Bank, has faced repeated threats of demolition under Israeli military orders.

Masafer Yatta, a cluster of Palestinian hamlets in Hebron governorate, has been subject to longstanding displacement pressures and demolition campaigns. Residents have sought to maintain their presence in the area despite military restrictions and construction bans imposed by Israeli authorities.
title: Israeli military orders demolition of homes and livestock pens in Masafer Yatta
